The Source Browser

The Source Browser is a dockable component that requires ctags (standard or Exuberant CTags (https://sourceforge.net/ctags)installations. You can enable the Source Browser in any of the following ways:

  1. Go to the View menu, then select 'Outline'.

When enabled, the source browser displays the logical layout of your source code as a source tree for the following languages:

  • Batch scripts
  • C
  • C++
  • C#
  • Fortran
  • Groovy
  • HTML
  • Java
  • JavaScript
  • Lisp
  • Lua
  • Make
  • MXML
  • Pascal
  • Perl
  • Python
  • Ruby
  • SQL
  • TCL
  • UNIX Shell scripts

Clicking on any nodes in this source tree autmoatically takes you to the specified location in your code.

The Source Browser can be configured via the Options dialog.
